answer: A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The comet counter is kept in wander and anchor publishes each reset. An copycat as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 194 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
